boundary: Live Supabase Auth, database, private Storage and actual Express routes. No browser, email-delivery or OpenAI calls.

checks.name: Two disposable real Auth accounts and password sessions
Authenticated capability and curated inspiration endpoints
Reviewed text inventory, unknown metadata, grouped quantities and collections
Explicit Favorites persistence and cross-account rejection
Settings persist optional gender and default occasion for the owner
No-photo analysis rejected at API and database enqueue boundaries
Private photo attachment preserves inventory ID and review status
Server-side filtering and pagination with collection metadata
Provided inventory preview is read-only and source-keyed
Concurrent import is idempotent and deletion leaves a ledger tombstone
Linking adds collections without replacing owned metadata
Missing-component templates stay separate and can be resolved
Flexible manual outfit saves only with explicit completeness
Atomic outfit edit retains wear history and feedback
AI save validation accepts explicit reviewed sets, rejects unknown coverage
